node.statement: Apply the preceding local fact to (a,W)=(c,U) and (d,V), obtaining cU,dV in calU without using node 1.1. Since lem-stage1-approximate-group-laws defines mu(A,B)=u_delta(A bold-dot B) for every A,B in calU, both X=U bold-dot V and Y=(cU) bold-dot(dV) belong to the domain S_delta of u_delta. Bilinearity gives Y=(cd)X. As cd is in U(1), lem-stage1-polar-coherence-naturality applied in this same polar chart gives u_delta(Y)=u_delta((cd)X)=cd*u_delta(X). Hence mu(cU,dV)=cd*mu(U,V)=c*d*mu(U,V).
